lines.en: label futabaspecial60p1:
scene black
I knock on Futaba’s door and wait for her to answer...
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Futaba 的门，等她来应门……

lines.en: But she never does.
lines.zh: 但她始终没有。

lines.en: And I go home without accomplishing anything.
lines.zh: 于是一事无成地回了家。

lines.en: {i}A few hours later, on the other side of town...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}几个小时后，在城市的另一头……{/i}

lines.en: {i}And roughly one hundred feet underneath the surface...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}以及地表大约一百英尺之下……{/i}

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks1
: And so concludes another successful adventure! This time, without anyone being forced out of their comfort zone or...
lines.zh: : 又一次成功的冒险就此落幕！这一次，没有人被逼出舒适区，也没有……

lines.en: : Or up against the door of a crowded train.
lines.zh: : 也没有被挤在拥挤列车的车门上。

lines.en: : You’ve been playing “those games” again, haven’t you?
lines.zh: : 你又在玩「那种游戏」了吧？

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks2
: Aye! But that has naught to do with my anecdote and {i}everything{/i} to do with why I must still {i}rely{/i} on those games! But I digress!
lines.zh: : 唉！可那跟我的轶事毫无关系，倒是跟我为什么还得{i}依赖{/i}那些游戏{i}大有关系{/i}！不过我扯远了！

lines.en: : Well...I’m glad you had fun, Molly. It was certainly a...productive trip, if not anything else.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我很高兴你玩得开心，Molly。这趟至少算得上是……收获颇丰。

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks3
: Did you wind up getting everything you need for your costume? Because I’m hoping to start work on them Monday and I’m...actually not even sure if I know what you’ll be going as this year.
lines.zh: : 你做 cos 服需要的东西都买齐了吗？我打算周一开始动工，而我……其实连你今年要扮什么都不确定。

lines.en: : Yeah...that’s kind of the problem. I’m not really sure what to do this time around. So while you and Yasu were fabric-shopping, I was...
lines.zh: : 嗯……问题就在这儿。这次我还没想好要扮什么。所以你和 Yasu 去买布料的时候，我在……

lines.en: : I was...buying...{i}other{/i} things...
lines.zh: : 我在……买……{i}别的{/i}东西……

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks4
: You went into {i}that{/i} section without me?! How could you?! And...how {i}did{/i} you?! They always stop me whenever I try!
lines.zh: : 你没带我就进了{i}那个{/i}区？！你怎么能这样？！还有……你是怎么{i}做到{/i}的？！我每次想进去都被拦下来！

lines.en: : If you were shopping for naughty things, God will find out and replace your arms with snakes. He sees all.
lines.zh: : 如果你在买下流的东西，上帝会发现的，然后把你的手臂换成蛇。他看着一切。

lines.en: : What?! No! I was talking about books!
lines.zh: : 什么？！不是！我说的是书！

lines.en: : Then why would you make it sound like you were doing something so impure?! I know lewd emphasis when I hear it!
lines.zh: : 那你为什么说得像是在做什么不纯洁的事？！我听得出来那种下流的强调语气！

lines.en: : Because I...I was talking about {i}those{/i} kinds of books, Molly. The ones Yasu isn’t allowed to read yet.
lines.zh: : 因为我……我说的是{i}那种{/i}书，Molly。就是 Yasu 还不被允许读的那种。

lines.en: : Do they contain inappropriate content?
lines.zh: : 里面有不当内容吗？

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks5
: Hah...yes, Yasu. Yes they do.
lines.zh: : 哈……有，Yasu。确实有。

lines.en: : Hmph. I hope you enjoy your snake arms.
lines.zh: : 哼。希望你享受你的蛇手臂。

lines.en: : Tch. You should’ve just said that from the start so I didn’t get my hopes up.
lines.zh: : 切。你从一开始就该说清楚，那样我也不会白高兴一场。

lines.en: : If you need recommendations for a costume, though- I’d be happy to help, Futaba. I started work on a Kafka costume for Tsuneyo but I had to bench the idea because it kept making me {i}feel things.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不过如果你需要 cos 服的建议，我很乐意帮忙，Futaba。我本来给 Tsuneyo 着手做了一套 Kafka 的服装，但我不得不搁置这个想法，因为它总让我{i}产生某些感觉{/i}。

lines.en: : I don’t think I...have the energy or confidence needed to pull that character off.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我……没有撑起那个角色所需的精力和自信。

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks6
: What are you talking about? You pulled Himeko off just fine and she practically bleeds confidence.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么？你扮 Himeko 的时候就很好啊，而她身上几乎浑身散发着自信。

lines.en: : Yes, but she also has a certain amount of...motherly energy that Kafka lacks. And I don’t want to walk around the Halloween party pretending that I like to...step on people.
lines.zh: : 是的，但她还有某种……母性的气质，那是 Kafka 所没有的。而且我不想在万圣节派对上到处走，装作自己喜欢……踩人。

lines.en: : Don’t knock it ‘til you try it, Xessaxia. At the rate you’re consuming those smut novels, you could very well unlock new aspects of your personality that even {i}I{/i} would gawk at.
lines.zh: : 没试过就别急着否定，Xessaxia。照你啃那些色情小说的速度，你很可能会解锁连{i}我{/i}都会看傻眼的性格新侧面。

lines.en: : Shh...we have a child with us, Molly. We can’t exactly talk about the things that “even you would gawk at.”
lines.zh: : 嘘……我们身边还有个孩子呢，Molly。我们可不能聊那种「连你都会看傻眼」的话题。

lines.en: : Nonsense. Yasu might be a child {i}now,{/i} but it’s only a matter of time until she has the same secret folders on her laptop that {i}we{/i} do.
lines.zh: : 胡说。Yasu {i}现在{/i}也许是孩子，但她迟早会在自己的笔记本电脑上，拥有和{i}我们{/i}一样的隐藏文件夹。

lines.en: : I abstain from using technology as it exposes me to information that has not yet been filtered through Him and opens me up to being falsely guided.
lines.zh: : 我拒绝使用科技，因为它会让我接触到尚未经过祂筛选的信息，使我容易被错误地引导。

lines.en: : Also, Touka says I’m not allowed. But I don’t want to anyway.
lines.zh: : 而且 Touka 说不允许我用。不过反正我也不想用。

lines.en: : Like I said...there is a child present.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的……这儿有个孩子。

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks7
: Hah...at this rate, I’ll be bitin’ the feckin’ bullet and just finishin’ the costume for Tsuneyo. Fantasies be damned.
lines.zh: : 哈……再这样下去，我就只能咬着牙把给 Tsuneyo 做的那套服装做完了。幻想什么的，去它的吧。

lines.en: : You’ve gotta figure something out sooner rather than later though, Futaba. The party’s right around the corner at this rate and if I don’t know what you’re after, I might not be able to help.
lines.zh: : 不过你得尽快想出点什么来，Futaba。照这个进度，派对马上就到了，如果我不知道你想要什么，我可能帮不上忙。

lines.en: : It’s fine, Molly. I’m nowhere near your level, but I still know my way around a sewing machine and can always just make my own costume if I really have to.
lines.zh: : 没关系，Molly。我离你的水平还差得远，但我对缝纫机还是驾轻就熟的，实在不行我也可以自己做衣服。

lines.en: : Besides, my interests are...{i}elsewhere{/i} for the time being.
lines.zh: : 再说，我的兴趣暂时……在{i}别的地方{/i}。

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks8
: How many of those books have you even read so far? I feel like that’s all you ever do now. It’s like you’re not even a real otaku anymore.
lines.zh: : 那种书你到底已经读了多少本了？感觉你现在就只干这个。你简直都不算真正的御宅族了。

lines.en: : I still keep up with the things we’re reading in club. But, as far as my personal books go, maybe...fifty this year?
lines.zh: : 社团里在读的东西我还是有跟上的。不过我自己看的书的话，今年大概……五十本？

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks9
: Friggin’ Christ, that many?! I don’t think I’ve read fifty books in my life.
lines.zh: : 我操，这么多？！我觉得我这辈子都没读过五十本书。

lines.en: : It’s not as much as it sounds. Just compare that to how much anime you watch.
lines.zh: : 没有听起来那么多。拿来跟你看了多少动画比一比就知道了。

lines.en: : I can finish most books in less than a week, so the time commitment isn’t nearly as bad as having to devote three months of my life to another unoriginal harem comedy.
lines.zh: : 大部分书我不到一周就能看完，所以花的时间远比把生命中三个月奉献给又一部毫无新意的后宫喜剧要少。

lines.en: : You leave the bread and butter of the anime industry out of this. Just because you’re becoming a normie doesn’t mean you get to talk down on us now. I won’t allow it.
lines.zh: : 你别把动画产业的饭碗扯进来。就算你正在变成普通人，也不代表你现在就能贬低我们。我不允许。

lines.en: : Trust me, if you knew what I bought today, you would certainly {i}not{/i} be calling me a normie.
lines.zh: : 相信我，如果你知道我今天买了什么，你绝对{i}不会{/i}叫我普通人。

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks10
: I am suddenly intrigued...
lines.zh: : 我突然来了兴趣……

lines.en: : And I am suddenly being tested again. But my faith knows no bounds, so your evil books will not tempt me.
lines.zh: : 而我突然又在经受考验了。不过我的信仰没有边界，所以你那些邪恶的书诱惑不了我。

lines.en: : Well, let’s put it this way- Nodoka wrote it. And, as I’m sure you know, she’s not exactly the most “wholesome” girl out there.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这么说吧——是 Nodoka 写的。而你肯定也知道，她可算不上什么「健康向上」的女孩。

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks11
: Nodoka? Like, {i}Nodoka{/i} Nodoka? The Goddess of Impurity herself? I knew she was a writer, but I didn’t realize she was actually {i}published.{/i}
lines.zh: : Nodoka？就是那个 {i}Nodoka{/i}？不洁女神本人？我知道她是写手，但我不知道她真的{i}出版{/i}了。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure she had her first work published when she was around...ten years old, I think? I’ve lost track of how much she’s put out since then. She never tells me about any of her new releases, though.
lines.zh: : 我很确定她的第一部作品出版的时候，她大概……十岁？我想是。从那以后她出了多少，我已经数不清了。不过她的新书从来都不告诉我。

lines.en: : I think she’s, like...trying to “preserve my innocence” or something. But, at this point, all innocence I once had is gone and I am now an all-encompassing ball of impurity that rivals even the Goddess herself.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她大概是在……「保护我的纯真」什么的。但事到如今，我曾经的纯真早就没了，现在我就是一颗包罗万象的不洁之球，连女神本人都能与之匹敌。

lines.en: : There is but one God and He is unrivaled. This is heresy of the highest degree.
lines.zh: : 神只有一位，而祂无可匹敌。这是最高级别的异端。

lines.en: : How...{i}long{/i} is this book, exactly?
lines.zh: : 这本书……到底有{i}多长{/i}？

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks12
: I’m not sure. Normal novel length, I guess? I don’t really know anything about it. But I’ll let you borrow it once I’m done if you want.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。普通小说的长度吧？我对它其实一无所知。不过我看完以后可以借给你，如果你想看的话。

lines.en: : She’s an extremely talented writer, but I don’t think I’ve ever actually finished anything she’s done before as her...{i}raciness{/i} was a little too much for me before I got into romance novels.
lines.zh: : 她是个极有才华的作家，不过她以前的作品我好像从来没真正读完过——在我迷上爱情小说之前，她的……{i}露骨程度{/i}对我来说有点过头。

lines.en: : I think I’m ready now but, then again, this {i}is{/i} Nodoka we’re talking about- so it’s equally possible that I’m going to put it down within minutes and be overcome by the urge to take a shower.
lines.zh: : 我想我现在准备好了，不过话说回来，这{i}可是{/i} Nodoka 啊——同样有可能我在几分钟内就把它放下，然后被一股想去洗澡的冲动淹没。

lines.en: : If this pseudo-normie book of hers is anything even remotely close to that last thing you said, I would very much like to borrow it.
lines.zh: : 如果她那本伪普通人的书，哪怕有一点点接近你最后说的那样，我也非常想借来看。

lines.en: : And I would very much like to burn it as it sounds like something that should not exist.
lines.zh: : 而我也非常想把它烧掉，因为它听起来像是根本不该存在的东西。

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks13
: It’s just a book, Yasu. And even if you disagree with what’s inside of it, burning it won’t do anything. We should be preserving literature of all types, not {i}destroying{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 那只是一本书而已，Yasu。就算你不同意里面的内容，烧了它也解决不了任何问题。我们应该保存各种类型的文学，而不是{i}毁掉{/i}它。

lines.en: : A terrible fate will befall you if you read this book. I can hear it in the screeching of the train upon the tracks. And the voice of my God tells me you must stay away.
lines.zh: : 如果你读这本书，可怕的命运就会降临到你身上。我从列车在铁轨上的尖啸里听得出来。而我的神的声音告诉我，你必须离它远一点。

lines.en: : Which reagents did you use to cast Divination just now? I need to make sure they’re worth at least 25 gp.
lines.zh: : 你刚才施展预言术用的是哪些材料？我得确认它们至少值 25 金币。

lines.en: : The air and all the thoughts within it.
lines.zh: : 空气，以及其中所有的思绪。

lines.en: : I’ll allow it.
lines.zh: : 我准了。

lines.en: : Yasu, it’s fine. Like I said, it’s just a book. If worse comes to worst and I feel a “terrible fate” creeping up on me, I can just put it down.
lines.zh: : Yasu，没事的。就像我说的，那只是一本书。万一真到那一步，我感觉「可怕的命运」正在逼近，我把它放下就是了。

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks14
: You do not understand! You are making the wrong choice! You’re damning us all!
lines.zh: : 你不明白！你在做出错误的选择！你在把我们所有人推向毁灭！

lines.en: : N-Nothing to see here, folks! She’s never been on a train before! She doesn’t know how this works!
lines.zh: : 各、各位，这里没什么好看的！她从来没坐过火车！她不知道这是怎么回事！

lines.en: : Yasu, shh! You can’t do that in here. Yelling is fine, but only if you wait until we get off, okay?
lines.zh: : Yasu，嘘！你不能在这儿这么做。喊是可以的，但得等我们下车之后，好吗？

lines.en: : But you-
lines.zh: : 可是你——

lines.en: : Shh!
scene black
: We can talk when we reach our stop...
lines.zh: : 等到了站我们再聊……

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks15
: {i}Hah...{/i}I’m glad {i}that’s{/i} over. Yasu’s always a handful, but I wasn’t expecting her to flip out on me like that.
lines.zh: : {i}哈{/i}……{i}总算过去了{/i}。Yasu 一向让人头疼，但我没想到她会对我发这么大的火。

lines.en: : I guess Molly and I will just have to talk about this in secret if she {i}does{/i} wind up borrowing it.
lines.zh: : 如果 Molly {i}真的{/i}借来看，那我和她大概只能偷偷聊这个了。

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks16
: That’s not important right now, though. It’s finally time to read.
lines.zh: : 不过现在那都不重要了。终于到了读书的时间。

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks17
: Ughhhhh...having a job is hard.
lines.zh: : 呃啊啊啊……上班真累。

lines.en: : Or not.
lines.zh: 也许不是吧。

lines.en: : Futabaaaaa...rub my shoulders...
lines.zh: : Futabaaaaa……帮我揉揉肩……

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks18
: Welcome home, Rika. I take it you...had an exhausting day?
lines.zh: : 欢迎回来，Rika。看来你……今天累坏了？

lines.en: : Exhausting is putting it lightly. I feel like I’m gonna die.
lines.zh: : 说累坏都算轻描淡写了。我感觉自己快要死了。

lines.en: : And...and what did you have to do exactly? Because I was...under the assumption your only responsibility was...being the advisor for the light music club.
lines.zh: : 那、那你具体得做些什么？因为我……一直以为你唯一的职责就是……当轻音部的顾问。

lines.en: : Yeah but nobody ever told me how much advice they’d need. And what’s even worse is I already forgot where the ropes are.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可没人告诉过我他们需要那么多建议。更糟的是，我已经忘了绳子放在哪儿了。

lines.en: : And...what did you need ropes for exactly?
lines.zh: : 那、你具体拿绳子做什么？

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks19
: Putting an end to my misery...
lines.zh: : 结束我的痛苦……

lines.en: : Please don’t.
lines.zh: : 别这样。

lines.en: : You want me to be miserable forever?
lines.zh: : 你想让我痛苦一辈子吗？

lines.en: : No...I want you to remain alive because I love you and Rin loves you. But, if it’s not too much trouble, I’d really like it if-
lines.zh: : 不……我想让你好好活着，因为我爱你，Rin 也爱你。不过，如果不太麻烦的话，我真的很希望——

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks20
: Whatcha got there?
lines.zh: : 你手里拿的是什么？

lines.en: : If I could read in peace for a little while.
lines.zh: : ——能让我安安静静地看一会儿书。

lines.en: : The Light of...Last...hey, wait a minute. I know this book.
lines.zh: : 《……最后之光》……嘿，等一下。我知道这本书。

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks21
: You...you do?
lines.zh: : 你……你知道？

lines.en: : Yeah, I was at the signing event for it. Were you there too?
lines.zh: : 是啊，我去了它的签售会。你也在吗？

lines.en: : No, I...I just got it today. And I didn’t even realize you read books, Rika.
lines.zh: : 不，我……我今天才拿到。而且我都没想到你会看书，Rika。

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks22
: I don’t.
lines.zh: : 我不看。

lines.en: : Then...why were you at the signing exactly? And...where even {i}was{/i} this signing? I would have liked to have gone.
lines.zh: : 那……你到底为什么会在签售会上？还有……那个签售会到底{i}在哪儿{/i}办的？我本来也想去。

lines.en: : Some book store. I don’t really remember. I just saw a line and got into it thinking there’d be something exciting at the end. And I guess I wasn’t wrong since there were a bunch of single women there, but...
lines.zh: : 某家书店。我记不太清了。我就是看到有人在排队，就跟着排了，想着队伍尽头肯定有什么好玩的。我想我也没猜错，因为那儿有一堆单身女性，不过……

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks23
: But all that did was awaken further darkness within me...
lines.zh: : 可那只是唤醒了我内心更深的黑暗……

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll...find someone else soon enough. And...hopefully somewhere else to stay.
lines.zh: : 我相信你很快就会……找到别人的。还有……希望也能找到别的地方住。

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks24
: What, are {i}you{/i} trying to get rid of me too now? I can’t even count on my second daughter to back me up while I’m homeless?
lines.zh: : 什么，现在连{i}你{/i}也想赶我走？我无家可归的时候，连我的第二个女儿都指望不上了？

lines.en: : I didn’t really mean that. You can stay here as long as you like. I was just kind of hoping I’d be able to read in peace tonight since Rin is working late.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思。你想住多久都行。我只是有点希望今晚能安安静静地看书，因为 Rin 要加班。

lines.en: : Are you calling me loud and unwanted? Does my presence bother you, Princess Futaba?
lines.zh: : 你是在说我吵又碍事吗？我的存在让你心烦了吗，Futaba 公主？

lines.en: : Your presence does not “bother me,” Mistress Rika. I simply require some alone time.
lines.zh: : 你的存在并没有「让我心烦」，Rika 大人。我只是需要一点独处的时间。

lines.en: : Are you even old enough to be reading this kind of stuff? Do I need to call your parents and tell them their daughter’s starting her “bad girl” phase?
lines.zh: : 你年纪够读这种东西了吗？要不要我打电话给你爸妈，告诉他们女儿开始进入「坏女孩」阶段了？

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks25
: You definitely don’t have to do that. In fact...{i}please{/i} don’t do that. I’d much prefer that the types of books I’ve been reading lately aren’t really divulged to or...known by {i}anyone.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你真的不必这么做。事实上……{i}请{/i}千万别。我更希望我最近读的那类书不要被泄露出去，或者……被{i}任何人{/i}知道。

lines.en: : Except your best friend’s mom, who now knows you’re up to no good.
lines.zh: : 除了你最好朋友的妈妈，她现在知道你在干坏事了。

lines.en: : Yes. Except my best friend’s mom, who now knows I’m up to no good.
lines.zh: : 是的。除了我最好朋友的妈妈，她现在知道我在干坏事了。

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks26

: Well, I {i}was{/i} planning on hitting the hay a little early tonight. But, considering you want your “alone time,” I guess I can see what Wakana and Imani are up to. Maybe Sensei will be there too.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我{i}本来{/i}打算今晚早点睡的。不过既然你想要「独处时间」，我想我可以去看看 Wakana 和 Imani 在干什么。也许 Sensei 也在那儿。

lines.en: : Are you and him getting along well?
lines.zh: : 你和他相处得还好吗？

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks27
: I...think so? Maybe?...
lines.zh: : 我……应该还好吧？也许吧？……

lines.en: : I thought we were, but...I’m not really sure how he sees me anymore.
lines.zh: : 我本来以为是的，可是……我现在不太确定他是怎么看我的了。

lines.en: : Did...something happen?
lines.zh: : 发生……什么事了吗？

lines.en: scene futabalikesbooks28
: Nothing you need to be worried about, kiddo. Aunt Rika’s just not the best when it comes to the impressions she gives people sometimes.
lines.zh: : 没什么你需要担心的，小家伙。Rika 阿姨只是有时候不太擅长给人留下好印象。

lines.en: : Well, if it means anything, {i}I{/i} think you’re great. And I’m sure Sensei will see that too.
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果这算数的话，{i}我{/i}觉得你很好。而且我相信 Sensei 也会看到的。

lines.en: : Hope so, kid. Hope so.
lines.zh: : 希望如此吧，孩子。希望如此。

lines.en: scene black
: Anyway, I’m out! Enjoy your book. That author girl was weird as shit. And she looks {i}mad{/i} similar to your friend with the glasses on the second floor.
lines.zh: : 总之，我走了！好好享受你的书。那个作家妹子古怪得要死。而且她长得跟你二楼那个戴眼镜的朋友{i}超级{/i}像。

lines.en: : I’m sure that was just a...coincidence...
lines.zh: : 我相信那只是……巧合……

lines.en: : Night, Futaba! Don’t stay up too late.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Futaba！别熬太晚。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Rika! Take your time coming home. I’m hoping to get at least the first half of this done tonight, and I have absolutely no clue how long that will take.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Rika！回来路上慢慢来。我希望今晚至少能看完前半本，而我完全不知道那要花多久。

lines.en: : Those other girls seemed to like it a lot, so I’m sure it’ll be a good time even if it’s quick. Like that time I fingered the singer of-
lines.zh: : 其他那些女生好像都很喜欢，所以就算很快看完，我相信也会很愉快。就像那次我用手指向那个乐队主唱——

lines.en: : Okay, Rika! Bye!
lines.zh: : 好了，Rika！拜拜！

lines.en: : Sorry! Bye! Have fun!
lines.zh: : 抱歉！拜拜！好好享受！

lines.en: : I’m sure I will.
lines.zh: : 我一定会的。

lines.en: : {i}I’m sure I will...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我一定会的……{/i}

lines.zh: {i}一小时后……{/i}
